RIGHT tree: a slightly leaning old silver birch, COMPLETE airy irregular leafy crown, pale creamy silver bark with charcoal scars, warm moss near twisting root flare, delicate dark branches visible through light yellow-green foliage. A little grouping of copper shelf fungi at its base. Same overhead camera and coherent style, distinct silhouette.
